thread:
jordan: PR #4223 — add events.user_agent column + data-pipeline backfill. Migration adds nullable text column. Backfill is a separate job in the same PR. Can someone take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4223 cc @sanjay @lina

sanjay: on it, queueing for review now.

lina: quick q — is the column added with a default? prefer no default to avoid table rewrite.

jordan: no default, nullable only. backfill job will update rows in batches.

matt: heads up — ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN without default is usually fine, but ensure you're not running `ALTER TABLE events ALTER COLUMN user_agent SET DEFAULT ''` later. also, in prod we should avoid long transactions during backfill.

alicia: can you include a down migration and add a migration id in the header? linter flagged missing metadata earlier.

jordan: yes will add down migration and migration id. added a migration header in the last push.

deploy-bot: CI / migration-linter failed — migrations must include `-- migration_id: <uuid>` and a short description.

jordan: fixed (pushed 1765432120), removed SET DEFAULT, added down migration. backfill job includes batching (10k) + exponential retries.

lina: please also add a feature flag or rollout check so backfill won't run until we flip it.

jordan: good call — backfill gated behind feature flag `enable_user_agent_backfill` and has a dry-run mode.

matt: one more thing — for the pipeline update, ensure idempotency if job restarts. use an `updated_at` cursor & upsert semantics.

sanjay: also add a quick note in the migration PR description about table size & expected time. helps SRE plan.

alicia: I'll do a quick pass on the SQL; also add a small README how you verified locally.

jordan: thanks. I ran backfill locally on a copy with ~200k rows, took ~6m with batching. included logs in PR.

matt: LGTM assuming CI passes and DB team approves the lock/maintenance window. :thumbsup: 

sanjay: approved. leaving a comment about scheduling maintenance window for prod.

lina: approved.

jordan: thanks everyone — will merge once CI green and scheduling confirmed. marking for merge after 1765432145 :shipit:
